name: CyberSec Toolkit
description: A unified security workspace bringing scanning tools, vulnerability intelligence, threat analysis and automated reporting into one place, so investigations stay connected.
coverAlt: 3D desktop monitor mockup displaying the CyberSec cybersecurity platform website with an AI-powered vulnerability scanning dashboard in a dark purple interface.

designThinking.intro: We designed CyberSec Toolkit as a unified security workspace, bringing six essential capabilities together. The challenge was to simplify the experience, not the security information itself.
designThinking.problem: Security professionals rarely get everything they need from a single tool. A typical investigation means juggling port scanners, DNS lookups, SSL analyzers, WHOIS services, vulnerability databases and threat intelligence platforms. Findings then need to be collected, analysed and turned into reports through a lot of manual work.
designThinking.audience: Security analysts, penetration testers, security engineers, developers and cybersecurity students.
designThinking.coreChallenge: How might we bring the entire security investigation workflow into one intuitive workspace without hiding the technical details that security professionals actually need?
designThinking.designGoal: Simplify the experience, not the security information itself.
designThinking.research:
01. Who we studied
- Security analysts and penetration testers.
- Security engineers and developers.
- Cybersecurity students learning the workflow.

02. Tools we explored
- Shodan and Censys.
- VirusTotal and SecurityTrails.
- Nmap and Zenmap.

03. Recurring friction
- Security workflows spread across disconnected tools.
- Too much time spent jumping between platforms.
- Findings collected and analysed manually.
- Security data without a clear structure.
- Reports that take almost as long as the investigation itself.

Key Insight: The problem wasn't that there weren't enough tools. There were too many, and none of them really talked to each other.

designDecisions.title: Port Scanning
designDecisions.description: Discover open ports, exposed services and potential entry points across target systems.

designDecisions.title: DNS & WHOIS Analysis
designDecisions.description: Get domain records, ownership details and network information without opening another tool.

designDecisions.title: SSL/TLS Inspection
designDecisions.description: Inspect certificates, configurations and potential security weaknesses.

designDecisions.title: Web & HTTP Analysis
designDecisions.description: Examine web applications, HTTP headers and common security misconfigurations.

designDecisions.title: Vulnerability Intelligence
designDecisions.description: Connect scan findings with known CVEs and enrich results with relevant threat intelligence.

designDecisions.title: AI-Powered Insights & Reporting
designDecisions.description: Turn technical findings into easier-to-understand insights and generate structured reports in multiple formats.

name: Designer's Room
description: A roadmap-driven learning and community platform for designers: follow structured guidebooks like UI/UX Designer, learn topic by topic, and share thoughts and experiences with other designers. Think roadmap.sh meets TryHackMe, built for design.
coverAlt: 3D laptop mockup showcasing the Designer's Room platform with a guidebook roadmap page and community feed, in a clean modern interface.

designDecisions.title: One workspace, every tool
designDecisions.description: All security tools live in one place, eliminating tab-switching and keeping the entire investigation workflow connected.

designDecisions.title: Context before complexity
designDecisions.description: Scan results are enriched with relevant context, helping analysts connect findings and understand security risks without manually correlating data.

designDecisions.title: Consistency across tools
designDecisions.description: A unified interface and familiar interaction patterns across every tool reduce the learning curve and make complex investigations easier to navigate.

designDecisions.title: Insights, not manual reports
designDecisions.description: Automated reporting transforms raw scan results into structured, actionable insights, removing repetitive report writing and saving analysts time.

developmentDecisions.title: Content as structured data
developmentDecisions.description: Roadmaps, stages, checkpoints, topics, and progress are separate models. Topic bodies live in their own document table, and progress is keyed per user and topic. A view layer merges them, so the same system can support multiple guidebooks.

developmentDecisions.title: Useful state at every step
developmentDecisions.description: Each topic is done, in-progress, not-started, or locked. The states differ by shape and label, not just color: a check, a dot, an empty ring, and a dimmed ring with a 'Needs: Stage N' pill, plus aria-labels and Review/Start actions.

developmentDecisions.title: Community kept separate from the learning path
developmentDecisions.description: Community is its own area, entered from the roadmap's completion card ('Share your progress'). Learning flow stays focused on topics and progress, and the community layer is built separately instead of cluttering topic pages.

name: Notify-ED
description: Instant multi-channel grade notification platform for colleges: upload a roster, enter marks, and students get Email, WhatsApp and in-app alerts with delivery tracking.
coverAlt: 3D laptop mockup showcasing the Notifyed student grade notification platform website with automated email and WhatsApp alerts, featuring a clean cream and orange interface.

developmentDecisions.title: One mark, many channels
developmentDecisions.description: A single marks submission fans out to email and in-app alerts in parallel, so one channel failing never blocks the others. Providers stay swappable (SMTP or webhook for email, WATI or webhook for WhatsApp), with channel-specific message formatting.

developmentDecisions.title: Validate at the boundary
developmentDecisions.description: Roster upload checks file type and required columns, normalizes cells, and upserts on enrollment number so re-uploads don't duplicate students. Marks are range-checked in the API and enforced again by database constraints before anything is sent.

developmentDecisions.title: Delivery you can audit
developmentDecisions.description: Each email attempt is logged with channel, status, error message and timestamp, linked back to the mark. Failed sends can be retried from the history view, which updates the same log record.

name: Sedative Physio
description: An end-to-end design and development engagement for a physiotherapy education client, built to make discovering, enrolling and learning feel effortless. And yes, turn a few more visitors into students along the way.
coverAlt: 3D desktop mockup displaying the Sedative Physio educational platform

designThinking.problem: Physiotherapy students were jumping between scattered resources, hunting for courses, and piecing their learning together. There had to be a better way to bring it all under one roof.
designThinking.audience: Physiotherapy students at different stages of their learning journey, from discovering courses to accessing advanced clinical resources.
designThinking.coreChallenge: Bringing fragmented educational resources into one ecosystem without overwhelming students or complicating their learning experience.
designThinking.research:
01. User Research
- New visitors: Clarity, reassurance and easy discovery.
- Returning students: Quick access to courses, lectures and materials.

Key Insight: Separate course discovery from the learning experience.

02. Design Process
- Product & IA: Understand offerings and structure the platform.
- UX Planning: Simplify navigation and user journeys.
- Interface Design: Create consistent, high-fidelity interfaces.
- Responsive Design: Optimise experiences across devices.
- Design System: Build reusable components for future growth.
designThinking.intro: One connected learning experience that makes course discovery easier and learning more accessible across devices.
designThinking.designGoal: Create an organised, accessible learning environment that helps newcomers discover educational opportunities while allowing enrolled students to continue learning seamlessly.

designDecisions.title: Two experiences, one platform
designDecisions.description: We split the experience into two parts: a public-facing website for discovering courses and getting started, and a dedicated student space for everything that comes after enrollment. Different needs, different spaces, one connected ecosystem.

designDecisions.title: All kinds of learning, under one roof
designDecisions.description: Recorded lectures, live classes, webinars, clinical resources, MCQs and even 3D anatomy models. Rather than sending students on a tour of different platforms, we brought everything together in one organised learning environment.

designDecisions.title: Making course discovery less of a treasure hunt
designDecisions.description: We gave courses, content categories and key information the attention they deserved. Focused homepage sections and clearer content hierarchy helped visitors understand what was available without having to dig around.

designDecisions.title: Pick up right where you left off
designDecisions.description: Returning students shouldn't have to find their way around all over again. We kept navigation familiar and learning materials within easy reach, making it simpler to jump back into a course or revisit a lecture.

designDecisions.title: Learning doesn't stay on one screen
designDecisions.description: The experience was designed with desktop, tablet and mobile in mind from the beginning. Because students should be able to access their learning materials wherever they happen to be.

designDecisions.title: Built to grow, not just to launch
designDecisions.description: We created reusable components, consistent typography and shared visual patterns to keep the experience feeling like one product. It also gives the platform room to grow without reinventing the wheel every time something new gets added.

developmentDecisions.title: Development in progress
developmentDecisions.description: Developer is still arguing with the code.

illustrativeRevenue.assumptions: 5,000 visitors a month, courses priced ₹1,000–5,000, 1–3% conversion.
